title: MeterTamperSuspected
description: On-node analysis suspects interference with a meter. Inferred, so it carries confidence and MUST NOT be treated as a finding of fact. Evidential retention: it may become the basis of a prosecution and is read-logged.

items.description: Individual tamper indicator. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

score.description: Composite tamper score in [0,1]. Distinct from provenance confidence, which describes the reliability of the inference itself.

provenance.description: How the fact was inferred. `confidence` is required: this event is produced by inference, and consumers MUST NOT treat it as measured.
